class.name: RoadServer
class.description: Roads by their handles: a road is a path with a width and a speed limit, and each of its two ends leads on to the roads its links name - one for a road going on, several where roads part (a vehicle takes one of them), none at a dead end. The links are one-way: a road's end leads on to another road's end that it enters by, and the way back is a link of its own. Whoever reads a network from its data builds it (a plugin's scenery, from its roads, crossroads and turning places) and frees it ([method SceneryContentNode.roads_own]); the vehicles on it are [RoadVehicleServer]'s, reported here road by road. Nothing of it is drawn.

method.name: road_create
method.description: A new road, without a path yet.

method.name: road_exists
method.description: Whether [param road] is a road of this server.

method.name: road_free
method.description: The road goes, with every link leading onto it.

method.name: road_free_many
method.description: The roads go all at once: the links of the roads that stay are looked over once, not once a road.

method.name: road_get_curve
method.description: The road's path, from its start to its end.

method.name: road_get_length
method.description: The length of the road's path [m].

method.name: road_get_links
method.description: Where the road's end [param end] leads on, as [code]{road, end}[/code] dictionaries: the road entered and the end it is entered by.

method.name: road_get_position
method.description: The point [param offset] metres along the road from its start.

method.name: road_get_track
method.description: The track the road is laid along; an invalid RID for none.

method.name: road_get_vehicles
method.description: The vehicles reported on the road.

method.name: road_get_velocity
method.description: The road's speed limit [km/h], negative for none. A road laid along a track has that track's ([method TrackServer.track_get_velocity]), as a scenario changes it.

method.name: road_get_width
method.description: The road's width [m].

method.name: road_link
method.description: Leaving [param road] at [param end], a vehicle may go on onto [param next], entering it by [param next_end]; a way given again stays one.

method.name: road_report_vehicle_entered
method.description: A vehicle came onto the road, travelling toward its end [param toward] - reported by [RoadVehicleServer]; announced as [signal road_vehicle_entered].

method.name: road_report_vehicle_left
method.description: A vehicle left the road - reported by [RoadVehicleServer]; announced as [signal road_vehicle_left].

method.name: road_set_curve
method.description: The road's path, from its start to its end.

method.name: road_set_track
method.description: The track the road is laid along, from the track's start to its end: a vehicle on the road is reported on the track too, and the track's limit is the road's.

method.name: road_set_velocity
method.description: The road's own speed limit [km/h], negative for none - while it has no track.

method.name: road_set_width
method.description: The road's width [m].

method.name: track_get_road
method.description: The first road laid along [param track]; an invalid RID for a track no road is.

signal.name: road_vehicle_entered
signal.description: A vehicle came onto the road, travelling toward its end [param toward].
